item.tib: dmag dpon rgyal po'i gtor bskang
item.coloph: hris pa gyer med kyis mdzad/ sku gshen bcu gnyis la rgyud (brgyud/)de nas bla chen dran pa nam mkha' yis/ dmu tsa gyer med dang / ra khod ram la gdams pa'o/ de nas rin chen gter du sbas/ tha mar gter sgo phyes nas/ 'phel ba'i rgyu lags lho/ 'ol sgom phug pa'i dngos grub pa'o//
